@British_Airways Clearly some of those bags were oversized. And how can you calculate fuel etc. When you aren’t weighing th?
We're sorry you remain unhappy with our baggage policy. The cabin baggage on board will have been checked by the airport for acceptability.

customer_msg: Ba995 from Berlin and our bags are where? So much for buying business class tickets
brand_reply: Hi there. We're sorry your bag didn't arrive. Did you report it at the airport? You can track online for updates.

customer_msg: Hi, I am looking to fly from the UK to Grand Cayman next year (pref May), and it seems you have stopped doing direct flights. Please can you tell me if that is correct? Thanks
brand_reply: Hi Sarah. We haven't stopped doing direct flights to Grand Cayman. We just don't fly there every day.

context.text: @British_Airways Just read you’re improving meal offer on LH flights. What’s the new offer? When are the changes being implemented? Thx.
Hi David, we don't have any further information at the moment. More updates will be announced in due course.
@British_Airways Ok, thanks. I’m flying LHR-SIN in February and was wondering if I‘d notice any change, I should ask again in some time then?
Hi David. We'd suggest you contact us back next month to check for any further updates on our catering offers. You may contact us any time you wish as we're here 24/7 to help.

customer_msg: Good evening! Any news regarding the changes on the long haul inflight service (meals)? You told me to ask again this month.
brand_reply: Hi David. We still don't have any news on the changes yet.

customer_msg: Y’all, has had me on hold for 14 minutes. <link>
brand_reply: Hi Sarah. Apologies for the late reply. We hope you weren't kept waiting too much longer to speak to someone.

customer_msg: Oh you truly are the classiest airline about. Captain addressing the waiting passengers in the airport to explain why we’re waiting? Unheard of. You rock!
brand_reply: Thanks for the kind words Lucie. Which flight were you on? We can pass these on to the Captain.

customer_msg: Back at T5! Thank you #britishairways 🇬🇧 @ Heathrow… <link>
brand_reply: Hi Stephen. Nice to hear from you. Are you leaving or just arriving?

brand_reply: Hi Nikki. We're sorry the priority boarding didn't work out as you planned.
